subject: Computer Networking
title: 5G Advanced and 6G
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on 5G Advanced and 6G.

hook.text: 5G promised gigabit speeds. 6G aims for terabits. Speed isn't the point — it's what speed enables.

buildup.text: 5G Advanced adds AI-native features: self-optimizing nets, centimeter positioning, ultra-low latency.

discovery.text: 6G targets sub-terahertz bands. Enormous bandwidth, but walls block them even more than mmWave.

twist.text: 6G isn't just faster radio. It merges communication, sensing, and computing into one system.

climax.text: 6G timelines: 2030 for standards, 2035 for deployment. Early research, but enormous ambitions.

punchline.text: 6G won't just connect — it will sense, compute, and communicate as one.

quiz.question: What is a key difference between 5G and planned 6G capabilities?
options: 6G merges communication, sensing, and computing into one system
6G uses lower frequencies for better building penetration
6G eliminates the need for cell towers entirely

details.summary: 5G Advanced enhances current 5G with AI-native air interfaces, improved positioning, and extended reality support. 6G research targets terabit speeds, sub-millisecond latency, and sensing capabilities using terahertz frequencies, expected around 2030.
details.whyItMatters: Understanding the mobile network roadmap reveals what applications will become possible. 6G aims to merge communication, sensing, and computing into a unified intelligent network fabric.
takeaways: 5G Advanced adds AI optimization and enhanced positioning
6G targets terabit speeds and sensing integration around 2030
Each generation enables entirely new application categories

faq.question: What will 6G enable that 5G cannot?
faq.answer: 6G aims to enable holographic communication, digital twins synchronized in real time, centimeter-level positioning everywhere, integrated sensing that detects objects and gestures, and AI embedded in every network layer. Terabit speeds would support immersive experiences impossible on 5G.

faq.question: When will 6G be available?
faq.answer: 6G is expected to be standardized around 2028 to 2030 with initial commercial deployments around 2030 to 2035. Research programs in the US, EU, China, Japan, and Korea are active. 5G Advanced serves as the bridge technology while 6G matures.
